heading: Declaration
bodyCopy: I, the undersigned operator responsible for the consignment detailed above, certify that to the best of my knowledge and belief the statements made in Part I of this document are true and complete, and I agree to comply with the requirements of assimilated Regulation 2017/625 on official controls, including payment for official controls, as well as for re-dispatching consignments, quarantine or isolation of consignments, or costs of destruction and disposal where necessary.
As my consignment is in scope of the common user charge, I confirm I have read and agree to comply with the common user charge payment terms and conditions.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Wraps the declaration POST form; carries the hidden crumb, etag and submissionDate inputs and the submit button.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: 'review-form' is an IPAFFS-specific class, not a GOV.UK Design System component. It appears to be a purely structural/styling hook for the review-and-submit style forms and carries no semantic requirement.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: No component needed — a plain <form> with a govuk-button is the standard pattern. Drop the custom class in the rebuild.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Carries two opaque values named crumb and etag plus submissionDate, whose value '16 July 2026' mirrors the visible declaration date.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: The snapshot confirms the names, hidden types and values, but does not establish the server-side semantics or derivation of crumb, etag or submissionDate.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: n/a — transport concern. The rebuilt service should use its framework's own CSRF/concurrency mechanisms and derive the declaration date server-side rather than trust a client hidden field.

fields.name: submissionDate
fields.label: Date of declaration
fields.requiredEvidence: Not a user-mandatory CHED-P field. The legacy handler derives the displayed value from notification.partOne.submissionDate or the current date (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:61-70). Although the shared validator requires a submitted submissionDate, that validator is invoked only for CHEDPP and CHED-A, not CVEDP (service/src/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:36-46; validation/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:9-18).
fields.conditionalOn: Not user-editable — rendered as static text 'Date of declaration: 16 July 2026' and mirrored in a hidden input. The trace does not establish how the value is derived.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 142 (main.html; span#date-of-declaration and hidden input name=submissionDate both = '16 July 2026')

fields.name: crumb
fields.label: (hidden crumb field)
fields.requiredEvidence: Framework transport field rather than a user choice. The CHED-P template emits crumb as a hidden input (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/declaration.html:44-48), and the CVEDP POST path does not apply the declaration-field validator (service/src/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:36-46).
fields.conditionalOn: Present as a hidden input in the observed snapshot; its semantics are not established by the trace.

fields.name: etag
fields.label: (hidden etag field)
fields.requiredEvidence: Framework concurrency field rather than a user choice. The CHED-P template emits etag as a hidden input (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/declaration.html:44-48), and the CVEDP POST path does not apply the declaration-field validator (service/src/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:36-46).
fields.conditionalOn: Present as a hidden input in the observed snapshot; its semantics are not established by the trace.

fields.name: accept-and-submit
fields.label: Submit notification
fields.requiredEvidence: Submit action, not persisted notification data. For CVEDP the legacy POST handler does not require an acknowledgement field; it checks whole-consignment errors and submits directly (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:36-58).

fields.name: common-user-charge-rates-and-eligibility-link
fields.label: in scope of the common user charge
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditional informational link, not a user-mandatory field. It is rendered only inside the isBillable declaration paragraph (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/declaration.html:26-37).
fields.conditionalOn: Shown when the CHED-P notification is billable.

fields.conditionalOn: Shown when the CHED-P notification is billable.

openQuestions: Legacy source resolves the acknowledgement-checkbox question for CHED-P: the shared declaration validator requires declaration-agree only for CHEDPP and CHED-A, while CVEDP bypasses it and submits directly (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:36-58; validation/routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:9-18). The rebuild should confirm this legacy policy remains intended.

The rendered trace did not show the billable-consignment paragraph or its two external links, but the authorised CHED-P template includes them when isBillable is true (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/declaration.html:17-38; routes/handlers/importer/declaration.js:73-79). This is a conditional-state coverage addition, not a legacy/rendered-copy conflict.

This is the final journey step: clicking 'Submit notification' POSTs the form and navigates to /notifications/{chedRef}/confirmation (observed redirect to CHEDP.GB.2026.1525975/confirmation). The declaration copy references 'the consignment detailed above' but no summary/Part I detail is rendered on this page itself — the review/summary lives on the preceding page(s), so the declaration page is copy + submit only.
The declaration text cites 'assimilated Regulation 2017/625'. Verify this is the current/correct legal reference for the rebuilt CHED-P (it is verbatim from IPAFFS as of the 2026-07-16 trace).

No error state was captured for this page in this trace (0 errors). Any submit-time validation (e.g. record already submitted, etag conflict, double-click) is unobserved — marked as a gap for error copy. The button has data-prevent-double-click='true', implying double-submit is handled client-side.
submissionDate is sent from a client hidden field in IPAFFS; the new app should derive the declaration date server-side rather than trust the client value.

The shared DeclarationPage exposes an 'I/We have read and understood' checkbox (page-objects/notification/DeclarationPage.ts:6-8), but no admissible CHED-P workflow or test checks it: CHED-P clicks Submit notification directly (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:552; tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-notification.spec.ts:221). The checkbox is therefore not added as a CHED-P field; confirm that direct submission without an acknowledgement control is intentional.
